difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a morphism of categories cofibred in groupoids is smooth as soon as the lifting condition holds for small extensions (statement lines 2132-2138). The proof (proof lines 2140-2175) factors a general surjection into small extensions and runs an induction in which the induction hypothesis and the small extension case are applied in turn, producing the two morphisms required by the definition. H2: an induction with two inputs, written out in full.
